urls.rationale: Chapter 101 (General Assembly) houses the Joint Legislative Ethics Committee and the legislative-agent registration/expenditure-reporting regime (ORC 101.70-101.99).
Chapter 121 (State Departments) contains the executive-agency lobbyist registration/expenditure-reporting regime (ORC 121.60-121.69) and the Office of Consumers' Counsel lobbying provisions.

Chapter 102 (Public Officers - Ethics) defines the Ohio Ethics Commission framework cross-referenced by the lobbying chapters and houses financial-disclosure requirements that intersect with lobbying disclosure.

notes: Three parallel regimes expected per OH 2010 GT and OH 2025 structure: Ch. 101 (JLEC/legislative-agent), Ch. 121 (executive-agency lobbyist), Ch. 102 (cross-reference ethics). Pass-3 will fan out to leaf sections within each chapter.
